title: Mixing: Oh Woman, Oh Why by Paul McCartney | 1971
content:
Studio R-2, A&R Recording, New York City
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Dixon Van Winkle

Paul McCartney worked on mixes for his song ‘Oh Woman, Oh Why’ on 5 February 1971.

The song was being readied for a single release later in the month. McCartney wanted the release to coincide with the beginning of his court case to dissolve The Beatles’ legal partnership, as a show that he was still a creative force to be reckoned with.

‘Oh Woman, Oh Why’ was the b-side of ‘Another Day’, which was mixed on 8 and 12 February.
